title: The game seat in the boss lab, after review: the thermal no longer flashes every 30th frame, the 25 mm's kill rate restated per lab second (about 1 hp a second on the harness's aim, 5 at the nominal best), T is swallowed, and the seat's leaks and unmounts are closed
context: A review of 2026-10-09-boss-bait-game-seat-landed found a critical flash and several smaller faults, and questioned the landing's kill rate, which it quoted as about 1.2 hp per real (headless) second on the belief that headless advances the lab clock slowly. The fixes were made on refactor-run (not pushed) in e7ad02cc and bff764e7.
outcome: SUPERSEDES the landing entry on three points and keeps the rest of it (the seat, the units, the rules, the MK-9 count). (1) THE FLASH: the lab's render-cost probe (costMs, every 30th frame) drew the plain scene to the default framebuffer three times after the seat had drawn the FLIR picture and the monitor, so one frame in thirty showed true colour; while the seat is mounted the probe now times the seat's own frame (gl.finish after it) and costMs runs only without it. --boss-bait reads a 48 x 27 patch of the canvas centre in a rAF after the lab's own on 120 consecutive frames and holds each on the ironbow curve (within 0.06 of the FLIR table in RGB for 80 per cent of the pixels); before the fix it failed on frames 60, 90, 120 and 150. (2) THE RATE: the fight's clock (fight().clock) ran at 1.00 of real time in two --boss-bait runs on this machine (a kill of 60 hp at fight clock 70.5 s for 70.3 s real; another 44.9 s for 44.9 s), so the landing's premise that headless slows the lab clock was not what the numbers show for the fight; the old figure was a rate per lab second all along, about 0.85 to 1.34 hp a second on the harness's aim (the arena's clock, which the step logs as labClock, counts from the lab's start and is not the fight's). Per second of fire it is 1.07 hp (1685 rounds, 56.2 s at 30 a second, for 60 hp): 16 per cent of the nominal 0.22 hp a round landing, the rest scattered or flown past a moving foot in the two seconds. The nominal ceiling is 6.6 hp a second on target (BOSS_FIGHT.rotary.dps = 30 x 0.22), which with the game's 12 s of fire and 3.5 s of cooling averages 5.1 hp a second: 180 hp is 27 s of fire on target at best (about 35 s with the cooling), and 135 to 210 s at the harness's hit share. A player who leads well sits between; the figure for a human is not measured. --boss-bait now logs fightClock, hpPerLabSecond, labPerReal, rounds fired, firing seconds, hpPerFiringSecond and hitShare. (3) KEYS: T, the game's top view, is swallowed in the lab (a capture listener registered before the seat, as R's; the lab has no map and the seat hid its HUD for it); the landing's key list should read 1 2 3, V, P, Space, the pointer and the wheel, Esc to the tank, R. Also fixed: the camera's position and rotation are saved at mount and restored at unmount (the free orbit opened a metre from the pole); the KORP model's geometry, materials and textures are disposed before optic.dispose() detaches the platform (it leaked on every mount); a body reload keeps the seat mounted (the loading flag no longer unmounts it; the round restarts when the new body swaps in, so a falling MK-9 and the aim are reset then as for any new round, and the seat's tick waits for the load); the seat's explosions are prewarmed at mount. --boss-bait tightens R's aim to 3 m (2.5 to 2.7 measured), asserts the scene's scale and position given back in the free orbit and after Esc, T doing nothing, and the seat's panel node surviving a body reload both ways (a reload took 0.1 to 0.3 s with the model cached).
alternatives: Time the render cost on an offscreen target while the seat is mounted: more code, and the seat's own frame is the cost that matters.
Drop T from the records' key list and leave it live: rejected, it was one capture listener in the lab and sentry-pilot.js stays unchanged.
Remount the seat across a body reload: rejected, it reloaded the KORP model and the post chain for no gain; keeping it mounted costs a frozen seat tick for the load's length.
Keep the landing's 1.2 hp a real second as the figure: rejected, the fight's clock is the one the rates are quoted on.
evidence: scripts/browser-test.mjs --boss-bait from an APFS snapshot, headless on kainode: the thermal step failed with frames 60,90,120,150 off the ironbow before e7ad02cc and passes after (worst share 1.00 on 120 frames)

--boss-bait kill lines of bff764e7's tree: {real 70.3, fightClock 70.5, hpPerLabSecond 0.85, firedInKill 1685, firingSeconds 56.2, hpPerFiringSecond 1.07, nominalDps 6.6, hitShare 0.16}; an earlier run {real 44.9, fightClock 44.9, hpPerLabSecond 1.34, labPerReal 1}; the landing's own run was 50.2 s for 60 hp

--boss-bait free orbit camera [0, 10.4, 56] with the scene scale [1,1,1] and position [0,0,0]; body reload to brood and back with the seat's panel kept (292 ms, 108 ms); after R the aim 2.5 to 2.6 m off the middle; --boss and --boss-cam PASS on the snapshot; npm test 219, npm run check and npm run build green
The 6.6 and 5.1 hp a second are arithmetic on src/content/boss-fight.js and GUNSHIP_GUNS.rotary (rate 30, damage 0.22, heatSeconds 12, coolSeconds 3.5), not a measurement of a player
